name: FormSection
label: Form section
description: A part of a form or a settings page: a heading and its sentence, the fields in a grid, and the section’s own actions.

props.name: title
props.description:
The section's heading.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which FormSection does not expose.

props.name: description
props.description: A sentence on what the fields are for or what changing them does.

props.name: columns
props.description: How many columns the fields run to; they fold to one as the section narrows.

props.name: layout
props.description: `stacked` puts the heading above the fields; `aside` sets it in a column beside them, the settings page's layout, stacking when the section is narrow.

props.name: actions
props.description: The section's own controls, at the foot of the fields: a Save, a Cancel.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading's place in the outline. Defaults to 2, a section of a page.

props.name: divider
props.description: Draws a rule above the section, for a column of sections.

keys.note: It holds the fields and actions passed in, each a native control reached with Tab.

alternatives.name: Widget
alternatives.when: the section is a dashboard tile rather than part of a form
